person.name: Komalesh D. Patil
person.headline: Software Developer
person.summary: Software Developer with hands-on experience in full-stack development, specializing in Angular and ASP.NET Core. Proven track record in FinTech domain with expertise in FX derivatives trading systems and MIS dashboards. Strong background in machine learning and research with published work in computer vision.

Developed complex post-trade features like Rollover, Partial Early Take-up, Closeout, Deal Split, Cancel, and Rebook for accurate FX trade lifecycle management.
Built a detailed MIS dashboard for FX Derivatives using Angular + ASP.NET Core visualizing 10K+ monthly trade data points.
Created a dynamic, filterable PnL Tree Page with analytics per dealer, currency pair, and business unit to reduce analysis time.
Delivered full-stack FinTech systems integrating Angular and ASP.NET Core aligned with trader workflows.
